Brothers Pio and Sebastiano Esposito Make History for Italy

Brothers Pio and Sebastiano Esposito started for Italy in a Nations League match, marking the first time siblings had done so for the national team since 1915. Italy secured a dominant win against Turkey. In other Nations League matches, France secured a late win against Belgium with a goal from Olise, and Northern Ireland drew with Hungary.
